scope: Terminal audit of retained candidate-only measurement; this supplements, rather than rewrites, the original protocol, samples and receipts.
finding: The clean-environment Windows Python executable is a redirector. The parent monitored the Popen redirector PID only, while the actual interpreter workload ran under a descendant PID. Consequently parent sampled RSS/private values and RSS termination coverage describe the redirector, not the workload.

interpretation.exactOutputAndLifetimeEvidence: Valid for the retained deterministic synthetic workload; all actual children completed normally.
interpretation.actualChildReportedMemoryAndTiming: Valid Windows process peak and elapsed receipts for completed children; not sampled parent process-tree measurements.
interpretation.rssSafeguard: Not verified for the actual interpreter workload; its observed terminal peak happened to remain below the declared RSS limit.
interpretation.availableHostRamAndWallSafeguards: The parent sampled these values as declared; neither triggered.
interpretation.termination: Not exercised. The implementation would have targeted the redirector alone, which is insufficient to guarantee descendant termination.
interpretation.qualification: No inference, accuracy or full-pipeline capacity qualification. Original passed flags represent execution/equivalence only and must not be read as proof of correct workload RSS monitoring.

nextStep: Correct monitoring to retain exact owned redirector and descendant process identities, sample actual workload RSS/private memory, and stop only owned processes. Preserve this directory and request root authorization before a differently named exclusive rerun.
